155.description: This feature vector activates on Thai script characters and Thai text fragments.

99.description: This vector represents common Thai quantifiers, determiners, and nominal prefixes.

53.description: This vector represents Thai language characters, sub-word tokens, and words frequently ending with or containing the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Suea).

57.description: This feature vector activates on isolated Thai script characters, vowel markers, and linguistic fragments.

70.description: This feature vector represents numerical digits and numbers across different writing systems.

199.description: The feature vector represents laboratory and molecular biology techniques, specifically involving polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and related experimental procedures.

27.description: This feature vector represents common Thai noun-forming prefixes, morphemes, and linguistic roots related to abstract concepts, states, and qualities.
